title: Mutation Adapter manifest
description: Canonical metadata schema for mutation adapters under plugins/gaia/scripts/adapters/mutation-{stack}/mutation-adapter.json. Separate from the tool-adapter adapter.json contract so that tool-adapter discovery (list-adapters.sh, adapter.schema.json) is unaffected.

provider.description: Binary name of the language interpreter or mutation tool. Resolved via command -v for availability checks.

stack.description: Stack identifier this adapter covers (e.g., bash, python, go, java).

file-extensions.description: File extension allow-list for mutant generation. Each entry starts with a dot.

default-timeout-seconds.description: Default wall-clock timeout for a single mutant execution.

version-range.description: Semver range for the provider. Informational; not enforced at runtime.

mutant-format.description: How mutants are expressed. 'patch' = unified-diff files applicable with patch -p1. 'tool-native' = JSON batch descriptor for tools whose mutants cannot be expressed as source patches.

description.description: One-line human description of the adapter.
